title: Fatty Acid-enriched Euphorbia neriifolia Alleviates the NPIP-induced Lung Cancer Via Modulating Oxidative Stress and Apoptosis in Swiss Albino Mice.
authors: Chaudhary, Priya; Meena, Mukesh; Singh, Devendra; Janmeda, Pracheta
one_liner_zh: 该文研究植物提取物和亚油酸对肺癌的抗氧化与凋亡作用，仅含分子对接但非蛋白-DNA互作体系，无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: The current study aims to determine: (i) the effect of isolated compounds (ICs) from E. neriifolia leaf via TLC and HPTLC on the lung cancer target protein through molecular docking; (ii) the cytotoxicity (MTT; 3-(4,5-dimethylthiazol-2-yl)-2,5-diphenyltetrazolium bromide) and proapoptotic effect (DAPI; 4'-6-diamidino-2-phenylindole) of isolated linoleic acid (LA) in A549 cells; (iii) the in vivo anticancer potential of ENLE extract and LA against N-nitrosopiperidine (NPIP)-induced lung cancer in Swiss albino mice. Results revealed that LA was determined to be the better one among the studied ICs. This is due to its binding energy (-4.8 kcal/m and - 4.3 kcal/m), pharmacokinetic properties, and drug-likeliness. The LA decreased cell proliferation and viability above 400 microM after 24 and 48 h treatment. Apoptotic changes were revealed in treated adenocarcinoma (A549) cells with an IC50 dose of LA. The in-vivo analysis in Swiss albino mice (5-6 week old; 28-30 g) revealed that the administration of NPIP resulted in a reduction in body weight with a rise in serum levels of tumor markers (LDH, ADA, and 5'-ND), TP, and LPO. Metastasis markers (hexose, hexosamine, sialic acid, and uronic acid) with a concomitant reduction in the levels of enzymatic (SOD, CAT, and GPx), and non-enzymatic antioxidants (Vitamin E and Vitamin C) were also observed in response to NPIP administration. Moreover, high doses of ENLE, gefitinib (positive standard drug), and LA treatment significantly restored biochemical levels. Histological analyses showed restoration of normal architecture in the ENLE- and LA-treated groups. Immunohistology analyses revealed decreased p53 overexpression and normal CK7 levels compared with the NPIP group, indicating their protective effect. A high dose of ENLE after oral administration shows a remarkable decrease in tail length. The % tail DNA at a high dose of ENLE was determined to be 15.53 +/- 0.11. Thus, the current study findings provide indications regarding the therapeutic potential of ENLE and LA against NPIP-induced lung cancer.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在确定：(i) 通过TLC和HPTLC从E. neriifolia叶片中分离的化合物（ICs）对肺癌靶蛋白的分子对接效应；(ii) 分离的亚油酸（LA）在A549细胞中的细胞毒性（MTT；3-(4,5-二甲基噻唑-2-基)-2,5-二苯基四唑溴化物）和促凋亡效应（DAPI；4'-6-二脒基-2-苯基吲哚）；(iii) ENLE提取物和LA对N-亚硝基哌啶（NPIP）诱导的瑞士白化小鼠肺癌的体内抗癌潜力。结果显示，在所研究的ICs中，LA被确定为更优者。这归因于其结合能（-4.8 kcal/m和-4.3 kcal/m）、药代动力学特性和药物相似性。LA在24和48小时处理后，在高于400微摩尔浓度下降低了细胞增殖和活力。在IC50剂量的LA处理下，腺癌（A549）细胞中观察到凋亡变化。在瑞士白化小鼠（5-6周龄；28-30克）中的体内分析显示，NPIP给药导致体重减轻，同时血清肿瘤标志物（LDH、ADA和5'-ND）、TP和LPO水平升高。转移标志物（己糖、己糖胺、唾液酸和糖醛酸）水平升高，伴随酶性抗氧化剂（SOD、CAT和GPx）和非酶性抗氧化剂（维生素E和维生素C）水平的降低，也在NPIP给药后观察到。此外，高剂量ENLE、吉非替尼（阳性标准药物）和LA治疗显著恢复了生化水平。组织学分析显示，ENLE和LA治疗组恢复了正常结构。免疫组织学分析显示，与NPIP组相比，p53过表达减少且CK7水平正常，表明其保护作用。口服高剂量ENLE后，尾部长度显著缩短。高剂量ENLE下的%尾部DNA确定为15.53 ± 0.11。因此，本研究结果为ENLE和LA对NPIP诱导肺癌的治疗潜力提供了指示。
